# Cell-Cycle Bias in HSC Clustering

Quantifies how much each CC-regression strategy removes cell-cycle bias from
the HSC clustering. ARI(clusters, Phase) is bounded below by random cluster
assignment and above by perfectly phase-homogeneous clusters of the same size.

```{r setup}
library(targets)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

source(file.path("src/R/scrna-seq_utilities.R"))
```

```{r params}
N_SIM     <- 200   # simulations per bound
SET_SEED  <- 42
PHASE_COL <- "Phase"
PHASE_PAL <- c(G1 = "#4daf4a", S = "#225ea8", G2M = "#e41a1c")
STRAT_PAL <- c(none = "#999999", diff = "#4393c3", full = "#d6604d")

clust_col_from <- function(meta)
  grep("sNN_pca.*_res\\.0\\.1$", colnames(meta), value = TRUE)[1]
```

---

## Load metadata

Each Seurat object is loaded, its metadata extracted, then discarded
immediately to keep peak memory low.

```{r load-meta}
targets::tar_load(mpn_processed_hsc)
meta_none <- mpn_processed_hsc@meta.data
rm(mpn_processed_hsc); gc()

targets::tar_load(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc)
meta_full <- mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc@meta.data
rm(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc); gc()

targets::tar_load(mpn_processed_hsc_diffcc)
meta_diff <- mpn_processed_hsc_diffcc@meta.data
rm(mpn_processed_hsc_diffcc); gc()

# Named list for iteration
metas <- list(none = meta_none, full = meta_full, diff = meta_diff)
```

---

## ARI bounds simulations

### Lower bound — random shuffle

Cluster labels are shuffled randomly while preserving the total number of
clusters, breaking any association with Phase. Repeated `N_SIM` times to
obtain a distribution.

```{r sim-lower}
#' Simulate ARI lower bound by randomly shuffling compare_col labels.
#' Returns a data.frame: compare_col, sim, ari.
sim_ari_lower <- function(meta, ref_col, compare_cols, n_sim = 200, seed = 42) {
  ref_vec <- meta[[ref_col]]
  do.call(rbind, lapply(compare_cols, function(cc) {
    cmp_vec <- as.character(meta[[cc]])
    keep    <- !is.na(cmp_vec) & !is.na(ref_vec)
    ref_sub <- ref_vec[keep]
    cmp_sub <- cmp_vec[keep]
    set.seed(seed)
    data.frame(
      compare_col = cc,
      sim         = seq_len(n_sim),
      ari         = replicate(n_sim,
        mclust::adjustedRandIndex(ref_sub, sample(cmp_sub))
      )
    )
  }))
}
```

### Upper bound — phase-homogeneous clusters

Cluster labels are generated so that every cluster contains cells of only one
Phase. The number of clusters is kept identical to the actual clustering, with
clusters distributed across Phase levels in proportion to cell counts. Cells
within each Phase level are randomly split into that level's allocated
sub-clusters. Repeated `N_SIM` times.

```{r sim-upper}
#' Simulate ARI upper bound with phase-homogeneous clusters.
#' Returns a data.frame: compare_col, sim, ari.
sim_ari_upper <- function(meta, ref_col, compare_cols, n_sim = 200, seed = 42) {
  ref_vec <- meta[[ref_col]]
  do.call(rbind, lapply(compare_cols, function(cc) {
    cmp_vec <- as.character(meta[[cc]])
    keep    <- !is.na(cmp_vec) & !is.na(ref_vec)
    ref_sub <- ref_vec[keep]
    k       <- length(unique(cmp_vec[keep]))

    # Distribute k clusters proportionally among Phase levels
    counts      <- table(ref_sub)
    k_per_level <- pmax(1L, round(counts / sum(counts) * k))
    # Correct rounding error so total == k
    delta <- k - sum(k_per_level)
    if (delta != 0L)
      k_per_level[which.max(k_per_level)] <-
        k_per_level[which.max(k_per_level)] + delta

    set.seed(seed)
    data.frame(
      compare_col = cc,
      sim         = seq_len(n_sim),
      ari = replicate(n_sim, {
        sim_clust  <- character(sum(keep))
        cluster_id <- 0L
        for (lv in names(k_per_level)) {
          idx  <- which(ref_sub == lv)
          k_lv <- k_per_level[[lv]]
          sim_clust[idx] <- paste0("c", cluster_id + sample(rep(seq_len(k_lv),
                                                                length.out = length(idx))))
          cluster_id <- cluster_id + k_lv
        }
        mclust::adjustedRandIndex(ref_sub, sim_clust)
      })
    )
  }))
}
```

### Run simulations

```{r run-sims}
bound_dfs <- lapply(names(metas), function(s) {
  meta      <- metas[[s]]
  cc        <- clust_col_from(meta)
  lower     <- sim_ari_lower(meta, PHASE_COL, cc, n_sim = N_SIM, seed = SET_SEED) |>
                 dplyr::mutate(bound = "lower", strategy = s)
  upper     <- sim_ari_upper(meta, PHASE_COL, cc, n_sim = N_SIM, seed = SET_SEED) |>
                 dplyr::mutate(bound = "upper", strategy = s)
  dplyr::bind_rows(lower, upper)
})

sim_df <- dplyr::bind_rows(bound_dfs) |>
  dplyr::group_by(strategy, bound) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    mean_ari = mean(ari),
    lo_ari   = quantile(ari, 0.025),
    hi_ari   = quantile(ari, 0.975),
    .groups  = "drop"
  )
```

## Actual ARI

```{r actual-ari}
actual_df <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(names(metas), function(s) {
  meta <- metas[[s]]
  cc   <- clust_col_from(meta)
  compute_ari(meta, PHASE_COL, cc) |> dplyr::mutate(strategy = s)
}))

actual_df
```

---

## Plot

```{r plot, fig.width=6, fig.height=5}
strat_order <- c("none", "diff", "full")

# Join n_levels from actual ARI into bounds so x-axis is shared
ari_df <- actual_df |>
  dplyr::mutate(strategy = factor(strategy, levels = strat_order))

bounds_wide <- sim_df |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = bound,
                     values_from = c(mean_ari, lo_ari, hi_ari)) |>
  dplyr::left_join(dplyr::select(ari_df, strategy, n_levels), by = "strategy") |>
  dplyr::mutate(strategy = factor(strategy, levels = strat_order))

y_max <- max(bounds_wide$hi_ari_upper) * 1.12

ggplot(mapping = aes(x = n_levels)) +
  # Upper bound ribbon + line
  geom_ribbon(
    data = bounds_wide,
    aes(ymin = lo_ari_upper, ymax = hi_ari_upper),
    fill = "#2ca25f", alpha = 0.15
  ) +
  geom_line(
    data = bounds_wide,
    aes(y = mean_ari_upper),
    colour = "#2ca25f", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.7
  ) +
  # Lower bound ribbon + line
  geom_ribbon(
    data = bounds_wide,
    aes(ymin = lo_ari_lower, ymax = hi_ari_lower),
    fill = "#d95f02", alpha = 0.15
  ) +
  geom_line(
    data = bounds_wide,
    aes(y = mean_ari_lower),
    colour = "#d95f02", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.7
  ) +
  # Actual ARI: line + labelled points coloured by strategy
  geom_line(
    data = ari_df,
    aes(y = ari),
    colour = "grey40", linewidth = 0.6
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = ari_df,
    aes(y = ari, colour = strategy),
    size = 4
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = ari_df,
    aes(y = ari, label = strategy),
    vjust = -1, size = 3.2, colour = "grey30"
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(none = "#999999", diff = "#4393c3", full = "#d6604d"),
                      name = "Strategy") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = scales::breaks_pretty()) +
  labs(
    x        = "Number of clusters",
    y        = "Adjusted Rand Index\n(clusters vs Phase)",
    title    = "Cell-cycle bias in HSC clustering",
    subtitle = paste0("Dashed bands: 95% CI over ", N_SIM, " simulations")
  ) +
  ylim(0, y_max) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```
